featured_reviews.name: Superman
featured_reviews.review_text:
(Edited)Sharing my honest experience.
The pricing of the diamonds felt significantly overcharged for what was actually provided (Charged as Per 1 Lakh).Provided an EGL India certificate (E-F color, VVS clarity).

The total diamond weight is just 0.05 ct (very small melee diamonds), yet it was billed at a very high rate. After checking market prices, such small diamonds usually cost much lower even with good quality, so this part of the pricing seems heavily inflated.

Additionally, the making charges are also quite high, which further increases the overall cost without adding proportional value.

The value for money is not justified and felt misguided. I would strongly recommend buyers to:

- Verify diamond pricing, especially for small stones
- Compare with other jewellers before purchasing
- Don't trust Blindly

Overall, not satisfied with the pricing transparency.

Reply :Thank you for your response. Although the pricing was shared, it appears misleading as customers may not be fully aware of the actual value. I confirmed this with my uncle, who is in the diamond jewellery business, and he mentioned that there is no possibility these diamonds would cost around ₹1 lakh. I hope this serves as an eye-opener for others to better understand what they are purchasing and paying.”
